title: Falling, falling, but not yet fallen, still unfallen, but about to fall
html_source: Woah woah woah… “falling, falling, but not yet fallen?” You can’t help but revel in the complexity and beauty within this statement. Joyce paints an extremely vivid picture of the motion of falling but not yet having fallen. Just take a moment and really think about that image for a second and the kind of emotions that this moment evokes.
